title: Coinbase staking services operate
description: Coinbase offered staking services that allowed customers to earn rewards from supported proof-of-stake assets through an exchange-linked service.
notes: Start year follows the SEC allegation that the staking-as-a-service program operated since at least 2019.

title: SEC sues Coinbase over exchange and staking services
description: The SEC charged Coinbase with operating as an unregistered securities exchange, broker, and clearing agency, and also alleged unregistered offer and sale of securities through its staking-as-a-service program.
notes: Core regulatory event for this staking product record.

title: Court allows much of SEC case to proceed
description: A federal court allowed much of the SEC case against Coinbase to proceed while dismissing some claims, keeping staking and platform-regulation questions active.

title: SEC announces dismissal of Coinbase enforcement action
description: The SEC announced a joint stipulation to dismiss the civil enforcement action against Coinbase and Coinbase Global while stating that dismissal did not reflect an assessment of the merits of the claims.
notes: Dismissal event for the 2023 civil action.
